settings.title: World map: levels
settings.says: Conquering a place means answering its cards correctly in one run. With levels, only conquered places are reviewed; without levels, nothing changes.
settings.knownShare: Without levels, a place is reached when this share of its cards is known (%)
settings.mayChange: Learners may change this for themselves

leaving.one: With this setting {count} card leaves the regular reviews until its place is conquered.
leaving.other: With this setting {count} cards leave the regular reviews until their places are conquered.

settings.leavingNone: With this setting no card leaves the reviews.
settings.ownSays: Your own levels and pillar width for this course. Levels are always recomputed from your runs — nothing is lost.
settings.serverOld: Levels and runs start once the server has been updated. Until then, reviews work as before.
settings.serverOldArea: The server cannot store runs yet, so levels cannot be switched on. Until it is updated, every learner works with 0 levels.
settings.noWorldView: This base has no world map view yet. Levels only keep cards out of reviews for places shown on a world map, so for now nothing changes in reviews.
settings.openAt: The paths of a tower open
settings.openAtSays: Decides whether learners must conquer a tower fully before they may follow its paths, or may go on earlier.

run.title: Run · {name}

intro.one: {count} card in random order. A wrong answer comes back at the end until it is right. All right the first time: every level at once.
intro.other: {count} cards in random order. A wrong answer comes back at the end until it is right. All right the first time: every level at once.

run.result: {first} of {all} right the first time, {after} after one correction
run.notReached: Level {level} not reached this time — {pct} % needed
run.serverOld: Runs will be possible once the server is updated.
run.locked: First let every card appear once and conquer the places before this one.
run.perfectSays: every card right the first time. The highest award.
run.restartSays: Made a mistake? You can start the run over — to conquer it without a single slip.

map.noRoute: No path leads here from the start yet
map.empty: No places yet: a place is a topic that questions name in „about”.
map.turnHint: Ctrl + drag: turn and tilt · two fingers: turn, zoom, tilt
map.fullSays: The whole screen — Esc goes back to the full page
map.pageSays: The map fills the browser window; Esc closes it

panel.noLines: No path leads through here — learn its cards directly.
panel.nothing: Nothing to learn here right now.
panel.conquerStart: This path starts at {name}: conquer that tower first.
panel.reachStart: This path starts at {name}: reach level {level} of that tower first.
panel.towerFirstLevel: reach level {level} of the start tower first
panel.prepareN: First review what I don't know ({count})
panel.prepareSays: Only the cards that do not stick yet — a good preparation before the run.
panel.conquerSays: Answer all {count} cards — this conquers the tower

conquerUnseen.one: All {all} cards are asked — {count} of them was never asked to you.
conquerUnseen.other: All {all} cards are asked — {count} of them were never asked to you.

exploreSays.one: A story explains {count} card you have not met yet.
exploreSays.other: A story explains {count} cards you have not met yet.

noStory.one: {count} card is explained by no story — it is learned directly.
noStory.other: {count} cards are explained by no story — they are learned directly.

nav.runAll: all right first time: straight to level {upTo}

issue.none: For authors: the data of the map shows no problems.
issue.cycle: Prerequisites go round in a circle (kept together): {names}
issue.dangling: A reference in „{field}” points to nothing: {names}
issue.partAndPrerequisite: Field „{field}” is marked both as part and as prerequisite — read as prerequisite only: {names}
issue.unknownCondition: Unknown condition type „{type}” — treated as not met: {names}
issue.flowStartsLate: Story starts at step „{step}”, not at its first slide „{first}”: {names}

membersNotDetoured.one: {count} member of this thread has no detour leading to it: {names}
membersNotDetoured.other: {count} members of this thread have no detour leading to them: {names}

issue.requiresSiblingPrerequisite: Requires what a neighbouring stage requires instead of that stage: {names}
issue.lineStartsMid: The path starts in the middle of the world (a junction there): {names}
issue.noRoute: No way found — drawn as a straight line: {names}
issue.mislabelledRegion: Colour area named after a topic that is not its centre: „{name}” (centre: {names}) — name it in the view
issue.unitMissing: The story’s part does not exist: {names}

why.levels: because its runs reached the top level ({of})
why.share: because {pct} % of its cards are known now
why.tower: it starts at {place}, which you have conquered
why.openLevel: it starts at {place}, whose paths open at this level
why.entry: you now know what it requires

finish.autoGo: The next part starts in {s} s — touch to stay
finish.autoMap: Back to the map in {s} s — touch to stay
finish.paused: Paused — this part is not finished yet

home.repeatSays: Cards of conquered places, each once, in random order. Choose how well a card may be known at most.
